note: Shared L3VPN lexicon binding the clean standard and messy vendor sides (E11).

entries.label: L3VPN service instance
entries.definition: one L3VPN service / VRF instance across the network

entries.label: route distinguisher
entries.definition: the value making a VPN's routes globally unique; one logical value whether read from config or operational state

entries.label: import route target
entries.definition: the route-target community on which routes are imported into the VRF

entries.label: export route target
entries.definition: the route-target community attached to routes exported from the VRF

entries.label: VPN network access
entries.definition: the customer attachment to the VPN at a provider edge

entries.label: PE-CE BGP neighbor
entries.definition: the PE-CE BGP peering exchanging customer routes

entries.label: BGP keepalive interval
entries.definition: the keepalive interval for the PE-CE BGP peer

entries.label: IP connection / addressing
entries.definition: the IP addressing configured on the customer attachment

entries.label: service bandwidth
entries.definition: the contracted service bandwidth (a service-view construct)

entries.label: import routing-policy
entries.definition: a named routing-policy filter applied on import; NOT a route-target value (a common false cognate)

entries.label: vendor segment id
entries.definition: an Acme-specific segment identifier with no standard-model counterpart
